<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:6">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>הושיב ב׳ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 249:1">Yalk. Kings 249</cite> <he>נשים ב׳</he>) he placed court ladies in Jerusalem (forced them to leave home and serve at the palace); <he>מהו ב׳</he> what is meant by (why are they named) biraniyoth? <he>ביירן ציידן וכ׳</he> (not <he>ציירן</he>), he laid a trap for them, he caught them (ensnared them).
